items.ti_en: Congratulations to the Ohio State Senate for passing Senate Joint Resolution 10, which would require VOTER I.D. in Ohio Elections! Democrats fought hard against this, presumably so they can CHEAT. I am now asking all of my Republican friends in the State House to, also, PASS THIS NOW, and put a Constitutional Amendment on the Ballot so that the Great People of Ohio can vote to enshrine VOTER I.D. in the State Constitution. I will be watching, and am strongly supportive of this Resolution. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: 상원 다수당 지도자인 존 툰(John Thune)은 공화당원과 그들이 옹호하는 모든 것을 끔찍하게 대하는 국회의원을 즉시 해고해야 합니다! 그녀는 당시 상원 다수당 지도자 해리 리드(Harry Reid)와 버락 후세인 오바마(Barack Hussein Obama)에 의해 그곳에 배치되었습니다. 더 말할 필요가 있습니까? 그녀는 민주당에 수조 달러를 주는 것을 좋아했기 때문에 그녀를 유지하기로 결정한 Mitch McConnell(John Thune에게 매우 불충한 것으로 입증된 남자!)의 불쾌한 후계자입니다. 하지만 장벽을 포함한 공화당에 대해서는 제가 결국 "그 주위를" 1,000마일 이상 건설하고 국경 개방을 폐쇄해야 했기 때문에 그는 아무것도 주지 않았습니다! 그녀는 민주당을 지지하는 급진 좌파 미치광이로 알려져 있으며, 공화당이나 공화당 이념을 존중하지 않습니다. 예를 들어, 지난 밤 그녀는 다른 누구라도 쉽게 승인할 수 있고 승인했어야 했던 제안에 대해 우리에게 불리한 판결을 내렸습니다. 우리에게는 모든 권리가 있습니다
items.ti_en: Senate Majority Leader John Thune should immediately fire the Parliamentarian, who treats Republicans, and everything that they stand for, horribly! She was put there by then Senate Majority Leader Harry Reid, and Barack Hussein Obama, need I say more? She is a nasty holdover from Mitch McConnell (A man who has proven to be very disloyal to John Thune!), who decided to keep her because he loved giving Trillions of Dollars to the Democrats, but for the Republicans, including the Wall, where I ended up having to go “around him” to build over 1,000 Miles, and close up our Open Border, he gave NOTHING! She is known as a Radical Left Lunatic that caters to Democrats, and has no respect for Republicans, or Republican Ideology. Just the other night, as an example, she ruled against us on a proposal that would have easily been approved, and should have been, by anyone else. We have every right to change her, and should do so, IMMEDIATELY! President DONALD J. TRUMP
